security_review.coverage: Upstream release/security pages and pinned implementation inspection; not a comprehensive vulnerability attestation
security_review.libpng: Pinned 1.6.59 includes the upstream fix for CVE-2026-46675; older candidate versions were not selected.
security_review.zlib: Pinned 1.3.2 release incorporates upstream audit remediation.
security_review.remaining: No claim that release selection or local probes establish absence of vulnerabilities. Linux/native full C1 matrix and fuzz are still required.

build_contract.mechanism: Immutable codeload archive URL and SHA256 for each dependency; verify full cached archive before extraction/build. No mutable tag fallback, system-library fallback, runtime download or installer.
build_contract.offline: Once cache is populated, configure/build must work with network disabled; missing cache or wrong digest is a hard configure failure.
build_contract.shipping: Static private dependencies, PIC where required, hidden symbols; preserve SDK ABI20 export oracle. Propagate sanitizer flags to actual decoder objects.
build_contract.probe_build: Standalone local audit, not linked into ars_runtime_core and not a shipping target.

proposed_resident_budget_MiB.accounting: Check cumulative live reservations before allocation; member/pixel ownership moves into immutable result without duplicate publication copy. A worker reservation is charged in the parent before launch. This is a proposal, not implemented accounting.

zip_policy.zip64: Recognized disabled; reject before decoding after bounded envelope checks, never narrow 64-bit sizes.
zip_policy.data_descriptors: Support bit 3 only with exact central/local/descriptor agreement and nonoverlapping ranges.
zip_policy.crc: Check actual decoded bytes; declared sizes alone never authorize allocation.
zip_policy.paths: Validate strict UTF-8, NFC plus Unicode casefold aliases with bounded utf8proc_decompose/reencode; reject absolute/UNC/device/drive/ADS/backslash/traversal/symlink/duplicate/conflicting names. No extraction.
zip_policy.unknown_payloads: Only referenced, supported data is decoded; extension/code payloads never loaded as native modules.

json_policy.schema: Actual Draft 2020-12 engine against the two immutable local schemas; no partial hand-written replacement.
json_policy.strict: Reject duplicate keys, invalid UTF-8, trailing tokens, nonfinite/exponent overflow. Count depth/nodes/bytes before materialization.
json_policy.precedence: Budget preflight, structural/schema and complete semantic validity, then recognized disabled capabilities. BAD_ASSET outranks UNSUPPORTED for malformed combinations.
json_policy.issue: PMR DOM does not cover all schema-validation allocations. Pinned jsoncons standalone probe with a fixed 1 MiB PMR arena validates successfully but performs 36 global new calls requesting 1664 bytes outside PMR. Size-limited input is not the promised host allocation cap.
json_policy.upstream_allocator_note: Upstream changelog explicitly notes schema temporary allocations still use std::allocator; the local probe verifies the resulting mismatch with our required host cap, not an upstream contract violation.

native_probes.platform: Windows x64 / MSVC 19.51.36252.0, VS18 2026; not Linux conformance

schema_gate.expected: valid instance and zero allocations outside bounded PMR

decoder_gate.png: Actual 1x1 RGBA decode, six allocation sites, peak requested live bytes 8954; each allocation-failure cut and one-byte cap clean.
decoder_gate.zlib: Actual inflate, peak requested live bytes 7152, allocation-cap denial clean.
decoder_gate.utf8proc: Caller-buffer decompose/reencode: casefold Strasse alias, invalid UTF-8 rejection and required-capacity reporting.

audit_harness_corrections: Initial schema probe exhausted Windows default stack because its 1 MiB arena was on stack; moved to static storage before collecting the dependency RED.

Initial decoder probe header shifted malloc alignment by eight bytes on MSVC and crashed at setjmp. ASAN located the harness error; a two-word header preserves 16-byte alignment. Corrected allocator passes all fault cuts.
First ASAN launch lacked the installed runtime DLL in PATH; rerun with the matching compiler bin directory. No failed attempt is counted as PASS.
native_probes.reproduce: Extract probe_sources into build/c0-probe; populate build/c-deps from verified archives; cmake -S build/c0-probe -B build/c0-probe-out -A x64; cmake --build build/c0-probe-out --config Release --parallel 2; execute c0_schema_alloc (expected exit 1). Decoder ASAN uses -DC0_ASAN=ON in a separate build and matching MSVC ASAN runtime PATH.

probe_sources.CMakeLists.txt:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(C0AllocationProbe LANGUAGES C CXX)
add_executable(c0_schema_alloc allocation_probe.cpp)
target_compile_features(c0_schema_alloc PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(c0_schema_alloc SYSTEM PRIVATE ../c-deps/jsoncons/include)
set(zdir ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../c-deps/zlib)
set(pdir ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../c-deps/libpng)
set(udir ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../c-deps/utf8proc)
set(zfiles adler32.c crc32.c deflate.c infback.c inffast.c inflate.c inftrees.c trees.c zutil.c compress.c uncompr.c)
list(TRANSFORM zfiles PREPEND ${zdir}/)
add_library(c0z STATIC ${zfiles})
target_include_directories(c0z PUBLIC ${zdir})
configure_file(${pdir}/scripts/pnglibconf.h.prebuilt ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/pnglibconf.h COPYONLY)
set(pfiles png.c pngerror.c pngget.c pngmem.c pngpread.c pngread.c pngrio.c pngrtran.c pngrutil.c pngset.c pngtrans.c pngwio.c pngwrite.c pngwtran.c pngwutil.c)
list(TRANSFORM pfiles PREPEND ${pdir}/)
add_library(c0png STATIC ${pfiles})
target_include_directories(c0png PUBLIC ${pdir} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
target_link_libraries(c0png PUBLIC c0z)
add_library(c0utf STATIC ${udir}/utf8proc.c)
target_compile_definitions(c0utf PUBLIC UTF8PROC_STATIC)
target_include_directories(c0utf PUBLIC ${udir})
add_executable(c0_decoders decoder_probe.cpp)
target_compile_features(c0_decoders PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_link_libraries(c0_decoders PRIVATE c0png c0utf)
option(C0_ASAN "ASAN for native dependency audit" OFF)
if(C0_ASAN AND MSVC)
    foreach(t c0z c0png c0utf c0_decoders)
        target_compile_options(${t} PRIVATE /fsanitize=address /Zi)
        target_link_options(${t} PRIVATE /INCREMENTAL:NO)
    endforeach()
endif()

material_decision_required.recommended: Resource-bounded schema helper process, preserving the real Draft 2020-12 library and existing SDK ABI; do not weaken the memory limit or substitute a partial schema checker.
material_decision_required.alternative: Keep schema in-process only after a separately reviewed dependency replacement or allocator/regex-workspace remediation demonstrates complete bounded allocation coverage.

worker_proposal.boundary: Only schema validation of the same owned immutable JSON bytes; fixed trusted schemas; bounded verdict response. Parent still performs strict parse and all bounded semantic/geometry validation.
worker_proposal.windows: Owned process handle and Job Object memory/active-process/deadline cleanup; no arbitrary PATH binary lookup.
worker_proposal.linux: Owned child plus address-space/CPU limits, bounded pipes, timeout/kill/wait cleanup; no accidental inherited descriptors.
worker_proposal.failure: Crash, timeout, truncated reply or version/hash mismatch produces typed failure and zero published model; no unbounded respawn/retry.
worker_proposal.network: Resolvers only serve fixed compiled/local schema documents; no URI fetching. Resource isolation is not claimed to be a full hostile-code sandbox.
worker_proposal.trust: Trusted helper executable supplied by the build; do not execute asset-provided paths or commands.
worker_proposal.impact: Adds a helper artifact/process lifetime/IPC to the previously proposed native in-process design; packaging and deployment implications need owner scope acceptance.

material_decision_required.gate_to_continue: Owner accepts the exact helper-process scope, or an in-process replacement passes a new allocation gate. Existing C0/C1/C2 plan approval remains recorded; merge approval is separate.
